subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible and default-preserving, but it expands the model-facing write contract and backend operation contract, which is a maintainer-owned product/API decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Ask the PR to use a dedicated append tool or explicit mode field if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from overwrite writes.

options.title: Pause for a replacement branch
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if a narrower replacement proves the same behavior with a safer review surface.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once current-head CI and owner review are clean.
